name: Nonlinear Kerr stability
question: Do admissible small perturbations of subextremal Kerr metrics asymptotically settle to Kerr?
first_attack: Audit precise statement and prove a restricted case
dispatch_next: Compare Hintz v2 and Szeftel hypotheses and companion dependencies, and seek expert adjudication of scattering and asymptotic completeness.
dispatch_why: A manuscript may already settle this entry. The next step is the review's own check, not a new lemma.

claim_review_2026.primary_title: Nonlinear stability of subextremal Kerr black holes
claim_review_2026.claimed_theorem: Vacuum evolutions from sufficiently small asymptotically flat perturbations in a specified polyhomogeneous/weighted-decay class of any fixed subextremal Kerr solution settle to another Kerr solution.
claim_review_2026.scope_note: Covers |a|<M for the stated initial-data classes, not literally every 'admissible' perturbation without quantified decay or gauge assumptions.
claim_review_2026.known_caveats: Jérémie Szeftel also claims full subextremal stability in a separate September 30 manuscript, with its own companion estimates. Two claims are not the same as independent acceptance of either proof; compare data classes.
claim_review_2026.next_review: Compare Hintz v2 and Szeftel hypotheses and companion dependencies, and seek expert adjudication of scattering and asymptotic completeness.
